messages:
oncall-bot: Pager | SEV-2 | runtime.queueing.high in eu-west-2 - 85% workers busy, avg queue wait 18s, spike started ~10:14Z. alert_id=ALRT-9003
Priya: seeing user errors spike + large tail latency on embeddings and streaming routes. eu-west-2 only. Im looking at hot routes. @Marco can you look at KV evictions?
Marco: on it. initial read: prefix cache eviction rate doubled, many streaming clients holding long-lived connections. suspect head-of-line blocking.
Jin: recommend immediate shedding on streaming and throttling embeddings for low-tier tenants. we have per-tenant knobs.
Priya: ok plan: 1) apply streaming-shed for plan:trial and plan:basic 2) set token-bucket on /v1/embeddings to 30rps/token 3) reduce worker max_inflight from 180 -> 100 for eu-west-2 to reduce concurrency pressure.
Marco: commands: 
```bash
# disable streaming for low tiers
redwoodctl tenant update --filter 'plan in (trial,basic)' --set runtime.streaming.enabled=false --region eu-west-2
# set token bucket for embeddings route
redwoodctl traffic throttle --region eu-west-2 --route /v1/embeddings --policy token-bucket --rate 30rps --burst 60
# patch worker concurrency
redwoodctl cluster patch --region eu-west-2 --set runtime.worker.max_inflight=100
```
Priya: applying streaming toggle now. expect some clients to fall back to blocking responses. Ops-bot: note user-visible change.
(Ops-bot): Change recorded: streaming toggled off for trial/basic tenants in eu-west-2 by Priya at 1719009890.
Jin: token-bucket applied. observing immediate drop in long tail requests. queue depth: ~1100 -> 520 in 70s.
Marco: after concurrency patch, worker utilization dropped from 86% -> 62% and queue avg wait down to 6s. KV eviction rate trending down.
Priya: customer impact check: CUST-900 (mid-market) saw increased 429s on embeddings during throttle. They are on plan:pro so unaffected by streaming toggle. Marco, any signal that critical customers are impacted?
Marco: checked whitelist: no dedicated/enterprise customers impacted. CUST-900 is pro and got throttled — but they were on a bursty job.
Priya: Casey, can you reach out to CUST-900 TAM and offer temporary quota bump or queue drain assistance?
Casey: on it. I can give a one-time quota bump for their tenant to process backlog if they request. will mention recommended retry/backoff.
Priya: logging: increase sample rate for slow requests > 8s for 15m, capture stack traces.
Jin: also enabling short-circuit for known noisy embeddings models: route fallback to smaller model for non-enterprise tenants. command: 
```yaml
# route fallback rule
routes:
  /v1/embeddings:
    fallback_model: model-embed-compact
    fallback_filter: 'tenant_plan not in (enterprise,dedicated)'
```
Applying now.
Priya: metrics update: queue depth 1100 -> 180 over 10m, inflight 85% -> 48%, prefix cache hit +12%.
Ops-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied: streaming-shed low tiers, token-bucket embeddings 30rps, reduced max_inflight eu-west-2. Severity remains SEV-2.
Priya: preparing 30m handoff. summary for handoff: cause hypothesis = long-lived streaming + heavy embedding batch jobs causing KV thrash and head-of-line blocking; mitigations = streaming shed for low tiers, token-bucket for embeddings, lowered worker concurrency, model fallback for non-enterprise tenants; customer impact = CUST-900 saw throttling (429), trial/basic tenants switched to non-streaming responses.
Marco: follow-ups: investigate cache sizing and eviction policy, improve per-tenant streaming concessions, add alert to detect streaming-connection-count rise.
Casey: CUST-900 TAM notified; they'll confirm whether they want quota bump.
Priya: handing off to Jin at 1719010200. Jin, keep token-bucket until queue depth < 150 for 15m and only re-enable streaming gradually with per-tenant ramp.
Jin: ack. I'll take over and run checklist. will post any regressions. :hammer:
(Ops-bot): Handoff logged: Priya -> Jin at 1719010200.
Priya: thanks team, leaving tracing and logs capture on for next 30m.
